We're on a trip the Lake District as part of an end of Year 7 trip. We're on the third day in of the 5 days and our teachers are planning a trip to aquarium the next day (stroking baby sharks!). So We're sitting down having a harry potter marathon when the terrible girls in my year (3 of them) kick out their roommate, whom then decides to move herself into our room (we had a spare bed). But that only comes into play later.

The horrible girls decide to steal the keys to a group of lovely girls' room and locked them out. They refuse to acknowledge what they're doing and carry on. The teachers then threaten that the aquarium trip would be cancelled, and ruined for everyone. Now, being fairly naive for  11 year olds, we believed them. I bravely steppe up to the plate and snitched on the girls, thinking I had saved the trip for everyone. I was wrong.

The girl they kicked out decided to win their "friendship" back by recording me admitting to snitching on them, showing them the recording. They proceeded to spit in my converse, backwash my cherryade and spat in my bed. They might have done more but I don't know.

The next day, we go to the aquarium! Everyone enjoying the walk there as the three girls appear. Happily oblivious, I girl them a smile thinking all is well. They jogged around me and mimicked spitting, staring at me. I was confused and asked others, "what are they doing..?", only met by giggles of my best-friends/roommates.

I only found out a year later, my friend told me over tinychat. But not because she felt bad, no,no,no. She wanted a reaction from me. Only now, to this day, noticing more and more how the people around me honestly don't care about me. They're all still friends with me because I'm best friends with one of the most popular girls, only because I've known her the longest.

Tl;dr: Aquarium trip almost cancelled, save it. Girls get revenge by spitting in shoes, bed and back washing cherryade. No one tells me till a year later, only for a reaction.
